ARABIC — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Phonological awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.

2. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

3. When practising Phonological awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness.

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Public Presentation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Public Presentation.

8. When practising Listening for gist: Main idea., which approach is best? (1 mark)
